about: The real name of each policy question, law amount and budget line a bill can change (keyed by the catalog policy id or the question id), with what it does as a noun phrase, so a bill's short title and long title read like a bill's and not like a menu entry. The name is the short title's stem; the form word (Act or Ordinance) is added from the bill's own form. Names and purposes are authored (calibrated to the short and long titles in data/english/parts/legislation.json); the English engine composes the sentence. Owner, Oct 15, evening: a bill has a real name, not a description. Where a bill has several sections, the long title joins their purposes with the list conjunction. A budget bill sets amounts for the spending lines without a direction; it is named by the budget row.
